subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 2/5] mountd: handle unmountable paths and junctions in the netlink downcall

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch improves the handling of unmountable paths and junctions in the netlink downcall for NFS exports. It introduces a deferred request mechanism to handle cases where an export is not immediately available, allowing the kernel to retry the request after a certain time period. The patch also splits the lookup_nonexport function into two parts, one for checking if an export matches and another for checking if it's a junction, and factors out common per-request work into nl_add_export_req. This allows the kernel to handle referrals correctly even when the client has resolved the address.
